headline: An epic market rescue, the big move has finally arrived
summary: The central government has for the first time subsidised individual mortgage loans with interest and put direct funds into stimulating the property market. The move signals stronger official resolve to support housing.
why: China's property sector is a large share of its economy, so central-government support for home loans influences developers, banks and broader growth expectations.
